criteria.text: After `pdd lint --local` completes in a repository with valid Runtime interfaces and no warnings, the run shows its saved lint result as partial and local-only, with 0 warnings, 0 AI calls and no checks sent, instead of "no pdd lint result".

With a selected Story or no Story selector, saved evidence and JSON retain the actual inspected scope; text and JSON retain warnings, interface findings and the existing lint exit. Saving local evidence and reading it with `pdd test --read BATCH` need no sign-in, network or model calls.
A local result remains partial and local-only when it has no test rows. It never appears as a full pass or satisfies a full lint/check gate, pass cache or recent passing lint receipt.

The run reads only eligible results at or after its start and keeps the newest lint result, including a newer local partial result after an older hosted pass. Reading changes no files and starts no work.
If the state folder is inside the repository, or the local result cannot be saved, local lint exits 2 with a clear state error, does not claim a saved result and leaves previous results intact.

setup.isolation: Fresh temporary Git repository copied from unchanged upstream test/fixtures/harbor; external PDD_STATE_DIR per case; fixed injected clock and UUIDs. No credentials or live transport.
setup.production_flow: Invoke runPdd with actual local lint arguments, then readRunResults and resultLines for that same root/state and since. Inspect actual command-produced batch/summary using the shared saved-local-layout record contract; call usableResult on returned evidence. The offline-read case calls public runCheck for that same newly produced batch. Controls may seed unrelated historical batches, but target local evidence must come from the command.
setup.offline_guards: Authentication, fetch and model metadata callbacks fail if called; invalid PDD_RUNTIME_URL confirms local recording needs no origin validation. Reader state-tree hashes before/after must match.
setup.default_summary: partial: checked static admission and SVG layout (local-only). 0 warnings. 0 AI calls. No checks were sent.
